scope: National Assembly elections of 3 October 2004 and 21 September 2008, whole chamber (90 seats): national list votes and printed percentages for all lists (23 and 17), seats per list, entitled voters, voters, ballots, invalid and valid ballots and printed turnout, and both national-community elections (ranking points, candidates without names), from the commission's archived official result pages. Also: the 2011 report is now cross-checked against the commission's final results by polling station (figures unchanged). 2000 is not admitted: the archived 2000 pages are marked unofficial (neuradni, 99.93% of polling stations). Constituency results and candidate names are not covered.

owner_decisions.decision: Owner brief and answers "Accept for all four" (ZASP Art. 9) and "Register both" (www.dvk-rs.si, manual reading).
Owner brief "Four-country election completion": the owner asked for the exact links, then saved the 2000, 2004 and 2008 archive pages and the 2011 polling-station workbook by hand and supplied them.

reuse_right.basis: Official texts (ZASP Art. 9), owner reading; same basis as the other Slovenian admissions.

normalized_republication.basis: Totals, list votes, printed percentages and seats as printed on the official pages; 2004 lists named after persons shown by row number (two) or without the name (one); candidates without names.

raw_redistribution.basis: The saved pages and the 2011 workbook are kept in local-evidence/ by SHA-256 only.

acquisition_route.basis: The archive pages were read once in the browser pane to give the owner exact links; the owner saved the pages and the workbook by hand. The assistant downloaded nothing.

source_files_complete.basis: 2004 and 2008: index, results by list, results by constituency, national-community results and turnout pages, each marked official (URADNI IZID; Uradni izidi glasovanja; 2008 counted at 3,386 of 3,386 polling stations). No minutes or polling-station file was read for these years, so there is no second source (stated in the notes). 2011: the workbook's 3,914 station rows add up to its total row, which equals every figure of the report.

national_definition_complete.basis: List votes = valid ballots (968,772 and 1,051,827); valid + invalid = ballots cast ≤ voters ≤ entitled; printed turnout (60,65 and 63,10) and every printed percentage recompute; the 7 lists at or above 4% are the 7 lists holding seats in the printed composition table; D'Hondt over 88 reproduces the printed seats; both national-community elections (points) reconcile; 90 seats.

same_election_identity_complete.basis: Lists as printed (ordered by votes); title_sha256 kept; no link across elections.

electoral_system_metadata_complete.basis: The result pages cite no act; the 4% threshold and D'Hondt over 88 seats reproduce the printed seats. Linked to the institutional period from 2000-07-25.

vintage_decisions_complete.basis: Pages marked official in the commission's election archive; no adoption date is printed on them. 2004 Hungarian community: the page prints points but no statement of who was elected; the candidate with most points is marked elected, and the composition table prints two national-community seats.

continuity: None: no party register was reviewed, so no link is made between elections, even where a name repeats. continuous_party_series is 0.
